description: This file defines a feature for adding a follow relationship between users in a social media app. It includes a command class, a validator, and a request handler that processes the logic of following a user, including validation, database interaction, and profile retrieval.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for adding a follower relationship.

methods.description: Handles the process of creating a follow relationship between the current user and the specified username, including validation and database operations.
